Despite that, it is clearly shown with a USB 3.0 jack :(also w/ '''blue''' color) in the FCC photos. It's marketed as an '''AC1000''' device.. which appears to be :650Mbps capable (5GHz) and 300Mbps (2.4GHz). The FCC test report indicates that this device will be used :for a DWA-182 revision (rev. B1 / Bx?). It is also notes that the devices are electrically identical. ===Drivers=== There is a USB ID (2001:330e) for an RTL8812AU device named :as DWA-183 found in the driver set for [[Edimax EW-7822UAC]].
